sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2024 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2024 legislative session year.
rec: 2023 Final Proclamation Plan = the 2022 interim plan adopted as final (20 Senate districts)
Alaska Division of Elections, District Maps page ('conform to the Redistricting Board's Final Proclamation of Redistricting issued on May 15, 2023')

The Board adopted the interim plan as its final plan on May 15, 2023, in force for the 2024 election and the rest of the decade. Census reports no change in Alaska from 2022 to 2024. Checked in the cached cb_2024 file: the 20 Senate districts pair the House districts as in the May 24, 2022 designations.
